author_scope: Independent source-only held-out evaluation; no matcher, predictions, runtime proposals, or existing labels inspected.

selection_rule.versions: Select official tagged schema releases, preferring CDM 5.2.x to 5.4.x; use an earlier official release only if later migration has no meaningfully changed fields.
selection_rule.cases: Up to 3 bounded complete clinical/health-administrative tables, preferentially COST and PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD where official documentation describes migrations. Include all actual source fields in selected tables, aiming 10–30 fields per case. Target includes corresponding complete table plus at most 2 related tables or predeclared role-based distractor subsets if needed to stay bounded.
selection_rule.ground_truth: Match only an equivalent published semantic role in the counterpart schema. Use no_match when the target has no directly equivalent published role; derivation, splitting, aggregation, or reassignment of a role is insufficient. Use ambiguous only if official docs support several alternative equivalents. Names/sample equality alone cannot establish any label.
selection_rule.hard_negatives: Retain actual fields with related but distinct published roles, including standardized vs source values, event identifiers vs event type identifiers, and dates with different roles. Never fabricate fields or observations.
selection_rule.samples: Extract actual official example values when attributable to the exact field; otherwise samples=[] and mark schema-only.
selection_rule.context: Separately extract verbatim official descriptions, table identity, declared type, and explicit role/units/period metadata where published. No answer-derived context.
selection_rule.abort: Exclude a case if authoritative definitions or release identity cannot be verified; no padding or fake ambiguity.
